examples.name: Basic Text Deduplication
examples.code:
from datasets import load_dataset
from semhash import SemHash
texts = load_dataset('ag_news', split='train')['text'][:1000]
semhash = SemHash.from_records(records=texts)
result = semhash.self_deduplicate(threshold=0.9)
print(len(result.selected))
examples.explanation: Single dataset deduplication using default embeddings.

examples.name: Multi-Column QA
examples.code:
records = [{"question": "Q1", "context": "C1"}, ...]
semhash = SemHash.from_records(records=records, columns=["question", "context"])
result = semhash.self_deduplicate()
examples.explanation: Handle structured data with multiple text fields.
